notes:
- Loadout: weapon classes are tabs across the top (Pistols, SMGs, Assault Rifles, Shotguns, Marksman,
  Heavy, Launchers, Wonder Weapons, Melee), one class at a time. Locked guns and attachments look locked
  even when a prestige token could unlock them, and the token hint no longer pushes the screen wider.
- Optics fixed on the Tri-Burst (its carry handle comes off for a flat-top rail) and the Twin Barrels
  (on the rib; it tips open with the barrels). Every gun's optic now sits on the gun and clears its sights.
  The Twin Barrels' foregrip no longer floats when you reload.
- Iron sights have an edge: with no optic fitted, +15% aim-in speed, +10% move speed while aiming and
  8% less recoil.
- Dark Matter is the mastery camo: 2500 headshots and gun level 50 (melee and explosive weapons:
  Weapon Prestige 2). Already unlocked? You keep it.
- The Alpha's entrance: it drops in, lands in a crouch, rears up and roars (a new, much louder roar),
  beats its chest and stalks forward. No name card over its head during it.
- Pause stops everything in a hosted game too: rounds, events, grenades and the clock. Pop-ups wait.
- Pause menu camo progress: once every camo is unlocked, it shows the weapon's level and how far to the next.
- Supply drops show on the compass until they're opened.
- Shatterpoint (Cryo Freezer Tier III) is much stronger: a longer freeze, frozen zombies take double
  damage, and kills shatter in a bigger, harder burst that freezes what's left.
- The weapon bar shows each weapon's camo; Excalibur keeps its steel edges under a camo.
- Explosions only jolt your gun a little (a string of blasts used to flip it over).
- The Hand Cannon sits upright. The P-12's suppressor (and the Mag-50's) is a short, slim can.
- The Ice King / Ice Queen freeze is a little quieter.
- Customize: 14 more hair colours, 6 more outfits (Mechanic, Woodsman, Woodland Camo, Scrubs, Arctic,
  Night Ops) and 6 more skin tones.
- New pictures on the Play menu's Solo, Host Game and Find Game cards.
